eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>18y
* Has decision-making capacity and able to provide informed consent for research participation
* For patients undergoing SMA: Has active MyChart
* Able to speak and read English

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to consent
